verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe Genie Code as a built-in workspace assistant that generates and runs code, builds pipelines and dashboards, and debugs errors. It can also run as an autonomous agent that plans, executes, fixes errors and asks for approval before using tools, with parallel chats started directly from Genie Code. AI assistance is also embedded in SQL authoring, dashboards and Genie natural-language Q&A. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that delegated agentic tasks work reliably in practice.
